title: Career Renewal Guide
subtitle: How to Break Plateaus, Reignite Growth, and Reclaim Career Momentum

blocks.text: Even top performers hit plateaus. Causes include:

items: Staying too long in comfort zone.

blocks.label: Reflection
blocks.text: When was the last time you felt true growth in your role?
Clues you’re stagnant:

items: No promotion or role change in 3+ years.

blocks.label: Exercise
blocks.text: Tick the signs above that you relate to right now. What do they have in common?
Is stagnation **internal (you)** or **external (company/market)?**

blocks.label: Exercise
blocks.text: Write your top 2 reasons for feeling stagnant.
If you’re stuck, reset.

items: From mid-level finance manager to fintech product lead.

blocks.label: Exercise
blocks.text: Write 1 short-term + 1 long-term goal.
Plateaus often = outdated skills. Fix by:

items: Enrolling in MBA, CFA, or certifications.
Learning AI/data analytics for tech relevance.

blocks.label: Exercise
blocks.text: List 1 skill that would make you more marketable today.
Your next break may not come from HR—it’ll come from your **network.**

items: Connect with industry leaders on LinkedIn.

blocks.label: Exercise
blocks.text: Message 1 alum in a role you aspire to.
Mentors accelerate clarity. Coaches give structured push. Together, they:

items: Priya felt stuck in audit. A mentor helped her see which of her skills transferred to consulting, and who to speak to there. She moved into a consulting role within a year.

blocks.label: Exercise
blocks.text: Name two people who could mentor you, and what you’d ask each of them.
Sometimes stagnation requires **reinvention.**
Pivot = transfer skills + build new story.

blocks.label: Exercise
blocks.text: Write 1 pivot you’d consider in next 2 years.
A new story → new opportunities.

items: Narrative → “I’m moving from X to Y because Z.”

blocks.label: Exercise
blocks.text: Rewrite your LinkedIn headline for your pivot role.
Stagnation often impacts self-worth. Fix mindset by:

items: Talking to peers/mentors who’ve navigated it.

blocks.label: Reflection
blocks.text: Write 2 strengths you’ve consistently shown at work.

sections.title: From stuck analyst to strategy consultant

blocks.text: Rajat spent 5 years in audit with no growth. He upskilled in consulting frameworks, worked on his story, and moved first into a Big Four advisory team and then into strategy consulting.

blocks.label: Lesson
blocks.text: Skills + story = breakthrough.

sections.title: From mid-level manager to product manager

blocks.text: Anjali plateaued in FMCG sales. She used an MBA to rebrand, networked with alumni at tech companies, and pivoted into product management.

blocks.label: Lesson
blocks.text: Pivot + rebrand + network.

items: Mistakes: Staying passive, blaming company, ignoring upskilling.
